brand_identity.name: Medalyze HRMS
brand_identity.style: Professional, Minimal, Modern, Corporate, Clean, Fast, Accessible
brand_identity.logo_instruction: Create an inline SVG logo matching: green medical + healthcare-tech mark (green cross, heartbeat line, upward arrow, circuit/radar rings) with 'MEDALYZE' wordmark in dark green. Do not use placeholder images for the logo.

rules: DO NOT use Inter, Roboto, or Space Grotesk.
Always apply tight tracking (tracking-tight) to headings over text-2xl.
No full-screen gradients. Use solid colors and functional contrasts.
Use 'Tinted Grey' - ensure neutral greys lean slightly towards green to match the brand.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-slate-200. Cards should have no shadow or very subtle shadow-sm. The UI must feel crisp, cardless or flat rectangular.
visual_enhancers.radii: max 8px border-radius (rounded-md or rounded-lg). Do not use excessive roundness.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Flat Solid surfaces. Avoid Glassmorphism as this is a medical/enterprise tool requiring high legibility and trust.

desktop.navigation: Collapsible left sidebar (dark green background, white text) with an icon-only collapsed state.
desktop.dashboard_grid: High Density Grid (Mode B): tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 for stat cards.

mobile.navigation: Hamburger menu or bottom navigation bar.
mobile.dashboard: Mobile-first employee interface MUST prioritize massive, easily tappable action buttons for 'Start Break', 'End Break', 'Clock In', and 'Clock Out'. Make these span full width (w-full, py-6).

grids_and_layouts.tables: Compact, scannable table layouts with inline edit/actions. Data density is critical for Admin.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing (p-6, p-8) inside major containers to prevent text collision, but tight spacing inside data tables and stat widgets.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or slightly rounded (rounded-md). High contrast. Primary buttons should be dark forest green. Attendance action buttons should use the lime green accent for 'Clock In' and distinct colors for Break.
components.cards: Keep cards flat with subtle 1px borders. Do not overuse shadows.
components.forms: Use Shadcn Form components. Left-align inputs and labels.
components.charts: Use Recharts (via Shadcn) for attendance trends or leave balances.

rules: Minimal animations. Only use for micro-interactions (hover states, button presses, focus states).
Ensure all transitions are specific (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform) rather than 'all'.
Ensure text meets APCA/WCAG standards (4.5:1 ratio).
Use focus:ring-2 focus:ring-lime-500 focus:ring-offset-2 for keyboard navigation.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').

login_background.description: Modern medical office interior for login/auth page background.

rules: DO NOT use generic placeholder URLs (e.g., via.placeholder.com). Use only the URLs provided above.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the 'Medalyze HRMS' enterprise SaaS platform as described.
Implement Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) UI variations: Employee dashboard features large attendance/timer buttons, while Admin dashboard features high-density tables and stat cards.
Ensure 'data-testid' is present on all functional buttons, links, inputs, and tabs.
Install and use @phosphor-icons/react or lucide-react for all iconography.
Build custom SVG components for the Medalyze logo as described in brand_identity.
Use Shadcn UI components but heavily customize their Tailwind classes to reflect the dark green/lime green brand palette and flat corporate aesthetic.
Do NOT use standard SaaS blue; replace all Shadcn default blues with the brand's greens.
Do not center-align the main app container. Always maintain standard block layouts.
Provide clear, readable tables for Employee Management and Leave Management with inline actions.
universal_guidelines: Avoid generic, 'AI slop' aesthetics. Make the design feel like a premium, custom-built internal tool.
Create depth through intentional z-index hierarchy and crisp borders, not heavy shadows.
Never use emoji characters as icons.
Every interaction needs subtle micro-animations (hover, focus, active).
Missing categories should use relevant fallback icons or shapes, NOT placeholder image services.
